mechanism.claim: The directional response to an eight-hour high-volatility BTC path is nonstationary but can be estimated causally by an online logistic model updated only with already-matured prior path responses. Trade only upper-confidence current predictions, allowing continuation or reversal to change without peeking into the current or later outcome.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the pre-entry FTRL logistic score
mechanism.why_distinct: HVOFL is one sequential FTRL-proximal learner over an ordered normalized hourly-return path. Fixed ridge/tree classifiers freeze one fit; KNN retrieves static analogs; response memory averages one shock scalar; online expert rotation selects among handcrafted sleeves. HVOFL has no expert pool, candidate event reuse, OOS refit, funding, OI, volume, flow, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: current eight-hour variation must occupy its causal upper thirty-five percent and absolute model score its causal upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset high-volatility upper-confidence online-model clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.path: 96 exact completed five-minute closes [D-8h,D), grouped into eight ordered one-hour log returns
features.normalization: divide all eight hourly returns by sqrt(sum hourly_return^2), finite strict positive
features.counterfactual_label: sign(log(open[D+8h+5m]/open[D+5m])); strict nonzero; becomes available only at D+8h+5m
features.causal_update_order: before predicting at D, process every earlier source-valid example whose label availability<=D, once, in decision order
features.learner: binary logistic FTRL-Proximal with alpha=0.05, beta=1, L1=0, L2=1; z/n initialized zero; standard published coordinate update; no reset or refit
features.warmup: at least 120 matured updates before a prediction is eligible
features.score: dot(weight,current vector), finite strict nonzero; side=sign(score)
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared 95 five-minute close-to-close returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.confidence_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(score) over at most 270 prior post-warmup predictions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.eligibility: warmup, strict score, variation gate, and confidence gate

clock.feature_available: decision boundary after current path and all eligible prior labels are complete
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.causal_labels: historical entry/exit opens may be opened only after their availability time and solely for sequential model updates; current prediction outcomes and stage economics remain sealed
source_plan.execution_prices: current and later candidate outcomes sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: singleton online FTRL logistic path learner with causal matured-label updates and upper-confidence high-variation gating

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no feature, learner parameter, warmup, ranks, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
